DAL01 - COLO Internet Connectivity Disruption (Upstream Provider)

We are currently investigating a loss of internet connectivity affecting colocation customers in our DAL01 (Dallas) facility. The disruption is due to a down Dedicated Internet Access (DIA) circuit with one of our upstream providers.

Customers with IP addresses in the **38.147.81.0/24** range may be unable to send or receive traffic over the affected circuit.
